name: HydroAgent-Evals
description: As LLM applications and AI agents for Hydro rapidly evolve, reliable evaluation is essential. HydroAgent-Evals builds open evaluation datasets as shared infrastructure, designed for both human contributors and AI-assisted contribution tools. 大语言模型在水利上的应用或者水利智能体在蓬勃发展，如何验证、比较智能体的能力，测试是不可缺少的一部分，而测试集就变成了基础设施，我们需要测试集。同时面向人类贡献者和智能体贡献工具设计
